Provide an `EntryDataDriver` with `query_entry({ entry_id, signal })` and `query_entry_kind({ kind_id, signal })`. Add optional context queries when your document uses context-backed declarations. Return `null` for an actual missing record and propagate genuine I/O errors.

Wrap `EntryView` in `EntryPreviewProvider`, supplying the same Entry and Macro drivers. A Macro's `source.entries` can then open another real Entry. Pass the same `kind_palette` into the preview provider and outer Entry view; customizing only the outer card leaves nested syntax/previews on a different palette.

```tsx
<EntryPreviewProvider entry_data_driver={entries} macro_data_driver={macros}
  kind_palette={palette}>
  <EntryView entry_id="example.definition" entry_data_driver={entries}
    macro_data_driver={macros} kind_palette={palette} />
</EntryPreviewProvider>
```

Also import `/entry/style.css` and KaTeX CSS. For a host that already has the Entry and Kind objects, use `EntrySurface` rather than copying its HTML/CSS into a local renderer.

An Entry can store SNL plus explanatory Markdown, but the normal card shows the first nonblank representation, not both. SNL wins. Put prose-only chapters in Markdown or provide an explicit supplementary source reader if readers need both representations simultaneously. Typst content is a source preview here, not a compiled Typst document.

Attach title/source/preview activation through `interaction_ports`; only the host resolves a Pointer to an editor or route. Do not fabricate file pointers for conceptual guide chapters.
